description: This Java class 'AutoFitTextureView' extends TextureView to provide a custom view that maintains a specific aspect ratio, which can be set via the setAspectRatio method. It overrides onMeasure to adjust its dimensions based on the ratio.

classes.name: AutoFitTextureView
classes.description: A custom TextureView that adjusts its size to match a specified aspect ratio.

methods.name: setAspectRatio
methods.description: Sets the aspect ratio (width and height) for the view and requests layout update.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Overrides default measurement to adjust view size based on set aspect ratio.
